notice: TEST ONLY provenance for the frozen PCV3 Unicode artifact; contains public upstream Unicode data only.

normalization_table.modification: Removed only the isolated-generator pcv3_unicode18_generation build constraint; the generated Unicode-18 table data was not rewritten.

assignment_table.extraction: Exact assigned18_0_0 declaration extracted from the generated unicode/rangetable/tables18.0.0.go; no ranges were rewritten. The upstream generator derives the repertoire from UnicodeData.txt, including its First/Last ranges, rather than DerivedAge.

supplementary_recomposition.extraction: All 33 Unicode 18 canonical two-scalar compositions with at least one supplementary-plane operand, excluding Full_Composition_Exclusion entries; unmatched supplementary pairs never use the generated lookup.

normalizer_support.local_code_modifications: Retained the pinned x/text v0.40.0 support and existing sensitive-conversion annotations outside separately documented upstream v0.43.0 extractions. Adopted its three-21-bit-field uint64 recomposition-table reader/key construction while retaining the independent full-width supplementary guard and negative-rune defense. Replaced the complete compose and combineHangul function bodies with exact x/text v0.43.0 code to fix upstream issues 81001 and 81021: track intervening starters and continue ordinary canonical composition after Hangul. These NFC correctness fixes intentionally change previously incorrect credential bytes for affected sequences before the first release; experimental PCV3 volumes made with those old bytes are not guaranteed readable with the same password. Unicode-17 literal fixtures and the frozen volume corpus remain unchanged. Regenerated Unicode 18 tables and the supplementary pair set; changed frozen-version comments and removed the isolated generation table tag. The 1 MiB limits remain unchanged. The inherited internal Stream-Safe implementation is retained as a bounded evaluator; the outer credential profile now rejects any implicit U+034F insertion instead of accepting that extra mapping, and preserves explicit input U+034F as credential data.

table_reader_compatibility.extraction: Only recompShift=21, uint64 packed-entry decoding, and the corresponding full-width lookup key construction from buildRecompMap/combine. The existing supplementary guard and negative-rune defense remain; composition correctness updates are separately pinned.

normalizer_support.source_files_scope: Baseline x/text v0.40.0 source files; the separately pinned v0.43.0 table-reader and composition-function extractions override the corresponding portions.

composition_correctness.extraction: The entire brace-delimited bodies of compose and combineHangul are byte-identical to pinned x/text v0.43.0, verified by Go AST source offsets. Other composition.go code, including the inherited Stream-Safe policy and existing local sensitive-conversion annotations, is unchanged.
composition_correctness.compatibility: Intentional pre-release correction of formerly incorrect normalization bytes for affected experimental PCV3 passwords; no fallback to the defective normalizer. Previous Unicode-17 literal and corpus compatibility evidence applies to those cases within the accepted bounded profile, not a universal unchanged-byte guarantee. Inputs requiring implicit U+034F insertion are now rejected rather than mapped into different credential bytes.

output_tag_patch.purpose: Recognize Unicode 18 only for versioned output packaging; the inert tag is removed when freezing tables. No UCD parser, data transformation, validation, or normalization algorithm was changed.

commands: cd unicode/norm && go run maketables.go triegen.go -unicode=18.0.0
generator.reproducibility: Both commands were executed twice from the isolated pinned source and identical pinned UCD inputs; all three generated output hashes matched.

credential_profile.name: bounded Unicode 18.0.0 NFC without implicit CGJ
credential_profile.normalization: NFC for accepted inputs; no additional Stream-Safe mapping is accepted
credential_profile.admission: Valid UTF-8; assigned UnicodeData repertoire; at most 1 MiB before and after normalization; reject inputs for which the retained bounded evaluator would insert U+034F
credential_profile.implicit_cgj_policy: After the normalized output-size check, reject with RejectionCombiningSequence if normalized U+034F count exceeds input U+034F count. Clear the separately owned rejected output and return no credential bytes. Do not remove, replace, or silently insert CGJ.
credential_profile.explicit_cgj_policy: U+034F supplied explicitly in the input remains credential data; it is not ignored or stripped.

guard_soundness.invariant: No canonical decomposition or corresponding canonical composition has U+034F as result or operand; U+034F has CCC=0 and no decomposition. Canonical reordering preserves multiplicity, and algorithmic Hangul ranges exclude U+034F. An increased U+034F count therefore identifies implicit insertion, not NFC.

credential_profile.compatibility: Intentional pre-release domain restriction. Experimental PCV3 credentials formerly accepted through implicit Stream-Safe insertion may now be rejected; previous corpus and repertoire checks do not promise universal compatibility outside this bounded domain.
